name: Other God (CR 25)
body:
OTHER GOD
CR 25

XP 1,638,400
CE Colossal Aberration
Init +; Senses darkvision 60ft.; Perception +52
Aura frightful presence (60 ft., DC 35)

DEFENSE

AC 44, touch 21, flat-footed 20 (+19 natural, +2 Dex, +13 deflection, -8 size)
hp 595 (34d8 +442)
Fort +17, Ref +12, Will + 21
DR 17/-; SR 38

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.; swim 60 ft.; fly 60 ft. (poor)
Melee bite +32 (4d6 + 10), 2 claws +32 (2d8 + 10), 5 tentacles +30 (2d8 + 5 plus grab), 2 wings +30 (2d8 +5)
Special Attacks cone of confusion
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th)

At-will–detect magic, lesser confusion (DC 31), vision
7/day–confusion (DC32), mass charm monster (DC 34), nightmare (DC 33)
3/day–dominate person (DC 34), insanity (DC 36)
1/day–dominate monster (DC 37), symbol of insanity (DC 36), teleport

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 14, Con 35, Int 35, Wis 40, Cha 27
Base Atk +22; CMB +38; CMD +50
Feats Empower Spell-Like Ability (dominate person), Hover, Improved Natural Armor (12), Legendary Magic, Multiattack, Power Attack, Quicken Spell-Like Ability (dominate person)
Skills Acrobatics +39, Climb +47, Escape Artist + 39, Fly +39, Heal +49, Intimidate +46, Knowledge (arcana) +49, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +45, Knowledge (history) +49, Knowledge (the planes) +52, Perception +52, Sense Motive +49, Spellcraft +40, Stealth +39, Survival +52, Swim +47, Use Magic Device +42

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Cone of Insanity (Sp)

By directing its mind-scrambling visage towards an area, an other god may devastate the psyches of those before it. An other god may emit a 60 ft. cone as a standard action. Creatures within the code must make a DC 35 Will save or be driven insane as per the insanity spell (caster level 20th).The other god may not use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

Gate to the Far Realms (Sp)

The other god possesses knowledge that allows it to tear open the gates between stars and summon its servants into reality. An other god may use the gate spell by performing a ritual that takes one minute. Creatures summoned through such a gate possess the aberration type (don’t recalculate BAB, skills, or HD) and appear to be bizarre, alien versions of the summoned creatures. Any non-aberration creature that travels through the gate must make a DC 40 Will save each round that they spend on the other side of the gate or else go permanently insane as per the insanity spell (caster level 20th) as their minds are torn asunder by the sights of the far realms.

Protective Madness (Su)

Simply being in the presence of an other god causes a creature’s thoughts to become confused or terrified, and the creature’s actions reflect this. Blows are struck just a bit slower or more clumsily. Spells lack the same coherency and forcefulness that they normally possess. An other god adds its Charisma modifier to its AC as a deflection bonus.

Siphon Psyche (Su)

With a single, hungry thought, the other god can drain away the very minds of those nearby. As a swift action that provokes attacks of opportunity, the other god may force one creature within 30 feet to make a DC 35 Will save or suffer 4d6 points of Wisdom damage. Creatures reduced to 0 Wisdom by this attack must make a DC 40 Will save against L-damage or die from pure terror and a shattered mind.

ECOLOGY

Environment Underground or aquatic
Organization solitary
Treasure triple standard

At the very highest echelons of fey society, the sidhe lords and ladies rule over the enigmatic fair-folk and all the forces they control. Old and powerful pacts grant the Sidhe Lords their supernatural powers, but it’s the eons of experience these beings possess that makes them truly dangerous. It’s virtually unheard of for a sidhe lord to obtain its position of power without also acquiring an impressive repertoire of arcane knowledge, and the armories of the sidhe lords are filled with terrifying masterpieces of talented fey craftsmen.
